description: What changed lately for one destination country: recorded changes to its visa rules or official source pages, plus dated news that cites an official source. Each item carries its source and date. An empty list is the normal answer when nothing has changed.

country.description: Lowercase destination country code, e.g. 'de', 'ca' or 'uk'. 'gb' also works for the UK.

since_days.description: How many days back to look, e.g. 60. Default 60.

name: transita_recent_rule_changes
title: Recent rule changes
